question: How is the linga measure adjusted using the linga finger unit?
premises: An adjustment of one part less is indicated.
The unit used is the linga finger measure.
inference: The linga measure should be taken as one part less using the linga finger unit.
uncertainties: The precise referent of tad in tadekānaikabhāgaṃ depends on prior context.
